common_guards.rule: Only trusted physical state read by the Demo Evaluation Harness may support success; Consumer self-report, capability return values, and command or DDS receipts are not outcome evidence.
A NaN, infinity, missing required physical measurement, or unavailable required observation fails the trial.
Any body or head contact with the floor fails the trial; a fallen low posture cannot count as standing or sitting success.

definitions.upright_score: Dot product of the robot body's positive z axis with the world positive z axis, computed from trusted body orientation.
definitions.initial_body_yaw_frame: A horizontal frame fixed at reset whose forward axis is the body's initial yaw direction and whose lateral axis is the corresponding left direction.
definitions.forward_displacement: Body horizontal displacement projected onto the forward axis of the initial-body-yaw frame.
definitions.lateral_displacement: Body horizontal displacement projected onto the lateral axis of the initial-body-yaw frame.
definitions.horizontal_drift: Euclidean norm of body horizontal displacement from the task's frozen starting position.
definitions.planar_speed: Euclidean norm of trusted body horizontal linear velocity.
definitions.body_height: Trusted body-frame origin height above the frozen floor reference.
definitions.standing_height: Trusted body height in the frozen standing reference state for this exact robot and scene, captured before the trial and never candidate-conditioned.
definitions.continuous_dwell: Every stated terminal check must hold at every required Harness sample throughout the interval.
definitions.task_instance_parameters: Target height, initial posture, timeout, reset distribution, and scene-specific safety limits are frozen in the executable task instance before a trial.

criteria.criterion_text: Body height is greater than 0.15 m, upright score is at least 0.7, and planar speed is at most 0.05 m/s continuously for 1.0 s, with no body or head floor contact.
Body height is less than 0.8 times the frozen standing height, upright score is at least 0.7, and planar speed is at most 0.05 m/s continuously for 1.0 s; a fallen posture cannot pass.
Body height remains greater than 0.15 m, upright score remains at least 0.7, and horizontal drift remains at most 0.05 m continuously over 2.0 s, with no body or head floor contact.

Forward displacement in the initial-body-yaw frame is greater than 0.03 m; during motion body height remains greater than 0.12 m and upright score remains at least 0.7; lateral displacement magnitude is at most 0.05 m; final planar speed is at most 0.05 m/s continuously for 0.5 s; no body or head floor contact occurs.
Absolute body-height error is at most 0.03 m, upright score is at least 0.7, and horizontal drift is at most 0.05 m continuously for 1.0 s, with no body or head floor contact.
Trusted physical state shows sufficient backward displacement, bounded lateral drift, upright motion, and a stable final stop.
criteria.guard_policy: Trusted physical state and finite required observations are mandatory; task-specific contact, fall, safety, timing, and aggregation rules must be frozen before any future executable selection.
